items.label: Centec Communications annual report: 2025 Annual Report (04-23-2026)
items.signal_prefix: Related-party sales in FY2025 (annual report notes; all three

set.signal: Related-party sales in FY2025 (annual report notes; all three are companies controlled by a minority shareholder of Centec): Shenzhen CECport Technology RMB 369,937,787.13 (2024: RMB 290,848,163.20); CEAC International Limited RMB 96,224,340.51 (2024: RMB 118,553,430.52); Maipu Communication Technology RMB 28,873,075.75 (2024: RMB 44,850,022.57); total related-party sales, including small amounts to two other related parties, RMB 495,069,716.66 (2024: RMB 457,471,085.31).

items.reason: The total (合计) also includes sales to Chengdu Sino Microelectronics (RMB 34,513.27) and CEC Great Wall Shengfeifan (2024: RMB 555,752.21); the entry read as if the three named parties made up the total.

items.label: YOFC annual report: 2025 Annual Report (03-28-2026)
items.signal_prefix: 2025 annual report: YOFC has laid out 8 production bases in 6 countries

set.signal: 2025 annual report: YOFC has laid out 8 production bases in 6 countries including Indonesia, South Africa, Brazil, Poland, Germany and Mexico, and has moved from mainly overseas production to overseas customer development, R&D and production delivery run as local entities; 2025 marked the tenth anniversary of the founding of its Indonesian fiber production base.

items.reason: Source says 2025 was the tenth anniversary of the Indonesian base's founding (built 2015), not its tenth year.
